sentence: This project builds chemical tools that make strained cyclic peptides, which are chains of amino acids, and tests the methods on natural products.
This project sets up a program of research experiences in quantum computing placed in active research groups across the United States.
This project builds a learning-based control method and a perception system that help a human operator control a robot hand in a safe and intuitive way.
This project builds a mapping method that links the design model of a manufactured part to its as-built geometry, even with large deviations.
This project builds a sensor that watches liquid drug production in real time to detect particles and microbial contaminants, using imaging and deep learning.
This project studies how fat tissue and ovarian tissue sense amino acids from food and communicate to control egg production in the fruit fly.
This project studies how sugars on the cell surface affect the choices neural stem cells make about what type of cell to become.
This project studies how storms, fishing, coastal development and climate change affect giant kelp forests and the ocean around them.
This project uses mathematics to study how tiny particles called colloids move and interact between two electrodes in an electric field.
This project develops methods to model how errors spread in quantum computing algorithms and to filter out the noise they cause in the results.
This project develops ways to evaluate large language models used in healthcare and to reduce the problems caused by incomplete data.
This project studies the trade-offs among accuracy, robustness across patient populations and patient privacy in AI used in healthcare.
This project builds software that lets robots change what they look at as a task changes, so they act more quickly and learn new tasks more easily.
This project trains several large language models to act like mathematicians in different roles so they can prove hard mathematical theorems.
This project builds machine learning models from unlabeled data of particle detectors that other scientists can adapt to nuclear physics analysis tasks.
This project builds a way for robots to measure 3D scenes from images by using extra perspectives instead of matching features.
This project studies how serotonin helps shape the axons of the brain cells that make it in fruit flies, and how this affects brain circuits and behavior.
